cases.name: simple
cases.sql: SELECT 1 AS a

cases.name: where
cases.sql: SELECT region, sum(amount) AS s FROM orders WHERE status='paid' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
cases.sql2: SELECT region, sum(amount) AS s FROM orders WHERE (status = 'paid') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cases.name: cte
cases.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 x), b AS (SELECT x+1 y FROM a) SELECT * FROM b
cases.sql2: WITH a AS (SELECT 1 AS x), b AS (SELECT (x + 1) AS y FROM a)SELECT * FROM b

cases.name: window
cases.sql: SELECT order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC) rn FROM orders
cases.sql2: SELECT order_id, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY amount DESC) AS rn FROM orders

cases.name: lambda
cases.sql: SELECT list_transform([1,2,3], x -> x + 1) AS l

cases.name: lambda_colon
cases.sql: SELECT list_filter([1,2,3], x : x > 1) AS l
cases.serialize: ERROR:true msg=syntax error at or near ":"

cases.name: decimal_literal
cases.sql2: SELECT CAST(1.2345678901234567890123 AS DECIMAL(38,22)) AS d

cases.name: chinese_ident
cases.sql: SELECT 1 AS "金额", '中文' AS "地区"
cases.sql2: SELECT 1 AS "金额", '中文' AS "地区"

cases.name: cast_nested
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS t
cases.sql2: SELECT CAST(CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AS TIMESTAMP) AS t

cases.name: join_alias
cases.sql: SELECT o.order_id, r.region_name FROM orders o LEFT JOIN regions r ON o.region_id = r.region_id
cases.sql2: SELECT o.order_id, r.region_name FROM orders AS o LEFT JOIN regions AS r ON ((o.region_id = r.region_id))

cases.name: union
cases.sql: SELECT 1 a UNION ALL SELECT 2

cases.name: subquery_from
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 1 a) t WHERE t.a > 0
cases.sql2: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 1 AS a) AS t WHERE (t.a > 0)

cases.name: string_escape
cases.sql: SELECT 'it''s a "test"' AS s

cases.name: interval
cases.sql: SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS d
cases.sql2: SELECT (CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) + to_months(CAST(trunc(CAST(1 AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER))) AS d

cases.name: case_when
cases.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN 1=1 THEN 'a' ELSE 'b' END AS c
cases.sql2: SELECT CASE  WHEN ((1 = 1)) THEN ('a') ELSE 'b' END AS c

cases.name: qualify
cases.sql: SELECT 1 x QUALIFY row_number() OVER () = 1

cases.name: grouping_sets
cases.sql: SELECT region, status, count(*) c FROM orders GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region),(status),())
cases.sql2: SELECT region, status, count_star() AS c FROM orders GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((region),(status),())

cases.name: filter_agg
cases.sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE amount > 10) c FROM orders
cases.sql2: SELECT count_star() FILTER (WHERE (amount > 10)) AS c FROM orders

cases.name: struct
cases.sql: SELECT {'a': 1, 'b': 'x'} AS s

cases.name: params_like
cases.sql: SELECT ?::INT AS p
cases.sql2: SELECT CAST($1 AS INTEGER) AS p
